verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that connects AI agents/tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code to Statsig data, plus a separate Docs MCP server for documentation access, confirmed by both docs and probe evidence. Statsig here plays the tool-provider role (not the agent role), so serving an MCP endpoint is squarely in-category and well documented. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
